title: Approval Decision Request
description: Request body accepted by the development approval endpoints (POST /internal/dev/research-approval/decide and POST /internal/dev/script-approval/decide) and passed through to resolve_research_approval()/resolve_script_approval() respectively — one shared shape for both stages, since the decision contract is identical. See docs/architecture/research-pipeline.md#approval-actions and docs/architecture/script-pipeline.md#approval-actions.

revision_instructions.description: Required (non-empty) when decision is 'revision_requested' — enforced by resolve_research_approval().
